reviews.Author: Andrew Sigal
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 17, 2021
reviews.Text: I ordered a box, which arrived in perfect shape, except that the salt crystals were crushed. There was maybe one nice looking pyramidal crystal per tablespoon. The taste was nice, and the crushed crystals were crunchy but nothing like the picture. So I went through a return/replace. The new box was crushed and torn. The interior bag was intact, but, the contents were approximately as crushed as the first box. So, I am giving them 3 stars because, even crushed, it is a nice salt (and the price is good.) But, I am disappointed based on the picture. What I have received (twice) wasnt even close.
reviews.Title: Two packages, all crystals crushed

reviews.Author: James E Spence
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 11, 2020
reviews.Text: I read the reviews and gave it a try. I like salty food, maybe too salty; so I had high hopes that this would give a salty umami flavor. Similar to Accent if they made a kosher salt variety. Instead, it tastes similar to kosher salt, but not as salty. It's as if it has half the sodium in the same volume. This salt is more for if you need a hint of salt. Such as with caramel, chocolate, or anything sweet. The crunchy texture is great but for fries or crunchy dishes, I'd stick with fry salt, flavacol, or kosher salt. The crunch of the salt is lost with the crunchy food.
reviews.Title: Purpose Use Salt, Not for Salty Dishes

reviews.Author: Kenneth Craig
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on October 21, 2023
reviews.Text: I bought this salt because most shishito pepper recipes call for it. It has good reviews even people suggesting just snacking on the pure salt. I don’t get it because before buying this I wasn’t really even aware salt could be so bland. It’s like adding room temperature ice to a dish. It adds a crunch but not much flavor.
reviews.Title: I don’t get it

reviews.Author: Ken's Thoughts
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 13, 2021
reviews.Text: Its salt, add more and its saltier. I read all the reviews that paid glowing homage to this simple NaCl. Its Sodium chloride plain and simple. As a salt its a 5 star like all non iodized salts. As a so called finishing salt that adds levels of rapturized taste buds doing the hokey pokey. Forget it, its just salt. I been a salter my whole life and what I use the most is Mortons kosher salt. I was really excited thinking that there would be more of a sensory sensation but nope.
reviews.Title: Its salt

Looks great for topping dishes and sweets like brownies or caramels, but unless it melts into the food, it hurts the chompers.
